assemblies.name: Z-Back Axis Bench Build
assemblies.description: Assembles the Z-back axis module from individual parts. Z-Back uses the same plastic piece type as Y-Left. No endstop is attached to Z axes. Produces a complete Z-back axis module ready for mounting on the back frame face directly behind Z-front.
assemblies.learningFocus: Z-Back uses the same build procedure as Y-Left (same plastic piece type). No endstop. During frame mounting, Z-back must be aligned directly behind Z-front before motor-piece bolts are locked — verify both carriages are at equal height.

partGroups.name: Z Back Complete Axis Unit
partGroups.description: The fully assembled z back axis unit, ready for staging. Contains all bench-built components: carriage, idler, motor holder, rods, and belt.

steps.name: Stage completed Z-Back axis on bench
steps.instructionText: Z-Back axis assembly is complete. Place the assembled axis unit at the staging position on your bench. It mounts to the back face of the frame.

steps.name: Z-Back axis bench QC and label
steps.instructionText: Run the full bench QC checklist before labeling and setting aside: belt moves smoothly along the full rod length; rod ends are flush with the idler bottom; the idler and carriage bolt heads are on the same side; the toothed side of the belt is facing inward. Label the axis Z-Back using masking tape and a marker.

hints.title: Four-point QC and label Z-Back
hints.message: Same four-point QC. Label Z-Back. Set aside — it mounts on the back frame face directly behind Z-front.
